theorems.name: Submission.ind_const_multiple_integer
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (c : ℝ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), X ω = c * ∫ x in U, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume) → ∃ k : ℤ, c = k
